description: listContacts: List all contacts for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by a search term. Requires authentication. Returns each contact with its id for use in getContact, updateContact, deleteContact, or domain registration.

search.description: Optional search term matched against contact name, email, or organization.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: listContacts
